name: OpenMetricLab example suite

examples.name: Diabetes — held-out regression
examples.source: Public Diabetes regression dataset — bundled CSV fixture
examples.description: Held-out Diabetes targets with Ridge and Random Forest predictions for side-by-side regression evaluation.

examples.name: Iris — multiclass classification
examples.source: Public Iris dataset — bundled CSV fixture
examples.description: Held-out multiclass/binary classification labels with calibrated-style probability columns from logistic regression.

examples.name: Wine — multiclass classification
examples.source: Public Wine recognition dataset — bundled CSV fixture
examples.description: Held-out multiclass/binary classification labels with calibrated-style probability columns from logistic regression.

examples.name: Breast Cancer Wisconsin — binary classification
examples.source: Public Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer dataset — bundled CSV fixture
examples.description: Held-out multiclass/binary classification labels with calibrated-style probability columns from logistic regression.

examples.name: Digits — 10-class classification
examples.source: Public handwritten digits dataset — bundled CSV fixture
examples.description: Held-out multiclass/binary classification labels with calibrated-style probability columns from logistic regression.

examples.name: Horse silhouette — binary segmentation
examples.source: Public horse-silhouette mask — bundled image fixture
examples.description: Public horse-silhouette reference mask with a deterministic shifted/eroded prediction for metric demonstration.

examples.name: Three-label geometry — multiclass mask
examples.description: Deterministic three-label fixture for testing per-class and macro segmentation metrics; not presented as a real-world dataset.

examples.name: Shepp–Logan phantom — registration
examples.source: Standard Shepp–Logan phantom — bundled image fixture
examples.description: Canonical Shepp–Logan phantom with deterministic misregistration and residual registration error, plus landmark pairs for TRE.

notes: Regression/classification examples are bundled static CSV fixtures derived from public/open datasets.
Image examples are bundled public/standard fixtures plus deterministic perturbations.
Metric computation is performed by OpenMetricLab code; example data do not provide metric implementations.
Perturbed predictions are deterministic demonstration artifacts and are not claims about published model performance.
